response.sql: WITH per_invoice AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(li.product_price) AS mean_product_price, COUNT(li.invoice_number) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS li ON li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number) SELECT AVG(mean_product_price) AS average_invoice_mean_price, AVG(line_item_count) AS average_line_items_per_invoice FROM per_invoice

assumptions.assumption: Invoices with no non-missing price are skipped for the price average but included in the line-item count average.

alternatives.interpretation: Skip invoices with no non-missing price from both averages.
